New emoji, symbol and kaomoji picker with search and skin tones. Uyghur layout support, phone keypads, per-app bar visibility, photo themes and compact suggestion rows. Fixes for Shift, capitalization, long presses, launcher shortcuts and dictionary imports. Direct Boot input verified on Pixel 7a; Titan 2 Elite still uses Kika before first unlock. Both Full and No-accessibility APKs are available.
